tags.feature: Tomb Raider Pinball Questline is now available.
Williams™ Volume 3 Questline is now available.
Redesigned the shop UI with clearer bundle tagging, making it easier to see exactly what each bundle includes.
The Framerate Limit and NVIDIA Reflex toggles have been moved from the Advanced section to the Basic settings menu for easier access.
Capped the PinHall to 60 FPS to keep your system cooler and quieter while browsing the menu.
DualSense (PS5) controllers are now supported over Bluetooth on Windows. Performance may differ slightly compared to a wired connection.

tags.bug: Improved loading speed of the Event menu for a smoother experience.
Fixed an issue where Season token progress was incorrectly carried over between Seasons, causing players to start a new Season already maxed out.
Fixed an issue where players could continue earning season tokens even after reaching the maximum reward threshold.
Fixed an issue where the season name was not displayed correctly in-game despite being set in the backend.
Fixed an issue where Weekly leaderboards were displaying All-Time scores and not resetting as expected.
Favorite selections are now saved even if no table was played before closing the game.
Fixed an issue where a fantasy-themed background appeared twice in the selection list instead of the intended "siege" design.
Fixed missing French text for the next quest preview in the WMS1 Questline. Placeholder text no longer appears after completing a mission series.
Fixed an issue where players couldn’t change Power settings before starting a new game in Arcade Mode if a session was already in progress.
Fixed a case where the Grand Tournament completion notification would not appear.
Fixed the “Time Left” filter not functioning correctly.
Fixed an issue where the "Dress Code" achievement would not unlock even after equipping a Badge, Frame, and Background.
Fixed an issue where Steam avatars occasionally failed to load properly.
Resolved a distracting flashing effect on the apron.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted ball launch behavior in challenges to prevent automatic plunger shots from reaching the bumpers. As a result, leaderboards with infinite ball save challenges have been reset.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where, if a single token was earned for the bank heist mode and the table was restarted, the dot matrix display in the center of the screen would not appear after the intro camera.

notes.content:

Crypt of the Necrodancer Pinball

We are happy to announce that we released three new pinball machines into the game along with other other updates. Dive into the adventures of a new Williams Pinball machine and have one of the best pinball experiences on our new Zen Originals!

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[b]Real DMD Support[/b]

We have worked with none other than Freezy from the Visual Pinball Community to bring this feature to Pinball FX. After the update, you can use your real DMD cabs with Pinball FX on tables that support the original dot-matrix system.

[b]New Performance Technologies[/b]

We’ve implemented performance technologies for AMD, Intel, and Nvidia, which means that you should experience improved FPS and performance on your PC after today's update.

[b]Start your favorite tables with command lines[/b]

Being able to launch your tables with command lines has been a popular request in our cabinet community. We are happy to share that this feature has been implemented into the game so now you can start your favorite tables without navigating in the main menu.

We hope that you will like these new additions to the game and wish you a fun time conquering the leaderboards!

notes.title: Pinball FX Legacy Bundles
notes.content:
Hi Steam Players! 

I hope you are excited for the release of Pinball FX tomorrow - we know we are! 

I have an important pricing update for you today, allow me to introduce [b]Pinball FX Legacy Bundles[/b]. 

These are our way of offering a deep discount on DLC-s you have owned in Pinball FX3 that you might want to buy in Pinball FX now, or anytime in the future. 
[b]
We will be offering Bundles that include pairs of Pinball FX3 and Pinball FX content, and offer a 50% discount. [/b]

[b]Let me explain in an example: [/b]

The Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1 Pinball FX Legacy Bundle contains:

- Pinball FX3 Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1
- Pinball FX Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1
- a 50% discount. 

[b]What if you have Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1 in Pinball FX3? [/b]

- The monetary value of the PFX3 pack gets subtracted from the Bundle price
- You still get 50% off for the remaining PFX pack

Hopefully, this offers an option to enjoy these tables in the new game with the updated graphics, physics, and gameplay experience. Get them Day 1, or just pick them up later - we invite you to enjoy Pinball FX for many years going forward. 

Akos and the Zen team

notes.title: Pinball FX is coming to Steam on April 13!
notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans!

Pinball FX is finally here! Enjoy digital pinball at its finest as the game brings you the most advanced simulation in pinball with Pro Physics for every table in the library, 4K HDR visuals, and ray tracing. [b]New tables will arrive frequently![/b]

[h2]Brand new additions[/h2]

We have more than 20 new tables coming to Steam! Dive into the shadows of the big city, explore ancient, secret tombs, and hunt for treasure on the [b]Secrets and Shadows Pack[/b], explore the mansion on [b]The Addams Family[/b], or travel to distant words, prove your honor and cunning on 3 amazing tables of the [b]Gearbox® Pinball Pack[/b]… and more!

With the Steam release of the game on April 13, five more tables will make their debut in the game. Dive into the stunning atmosphere of the [b]Godzilla vs Kong Pinball Pack[/b], everyone’s favorite [b]Twilight Zone[/b], and a table with a new concept and mechanics: [b]Crypt of the NecroDancer Pinball[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/108525595113017b79630b479871a5f595720de4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Remastered Tables[/h2]

Legacy tables reloaded! In our library, every legacy table has been updated with the latest iteration of [b]Pro Physics[/b] and enhanced with [b]upgraded visuals[/b] to give you the smoothest pinball experience. Don’t worry if you can’t find your favorites in the library yet, they will come at a later date in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/5c731c18b0451343b98ffe1728ed83de3badf4ce.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build your dream game room[/h2]

Build up your own customizable 3D playroom with collectible items unlocked by playing. Display your pinball mastery by achieving the unique table awards and displaying them in the PinHall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43901061/317439690aae339ca07e004173e361e858315a8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Events & Tournaments[/h2]

Compete with other members of the community in user-generated tournaments or official events for trophies you can display in your game room!

[h2]Cabinet Mode[/h2]

Thanks to your feedback during the Early Access period, we upgraded our cabinet mode to give you a smoother experience on your own digital cabinet!

[h2]Don’t forget to wishlist the game on the store page![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328760?utm_source=steamnews

[b]Check out the Pinball Bites for all the trailers, announcements, and more:[/b]

[previewyoutube=cxYC_XYqHL0;full][/previewyoutube]

See you on the leaderboards!
